commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Shots on target – 10:3.
90+4' Oscar Estupinan (Metz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Metz.
87' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' 3 - 0 Frank Magri (Toulouse) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes into the top right corner.
81' Substitution. Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) on for Cesar Gelabert Pina.
78' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
75' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Gael Angoula and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) will replace Mikkel Desler.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
70' Here is a change. Simon Elisor is going off and Laszlo Boloni gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Estupinan (Metz).
70' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
68' A cross into the box from Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) is cleared.
65' That will be all from Niklas Schmidt who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Vincent Sierro (Toulouse).
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Aron Donnum as he is replaced by Mamady Bangre (Toulouse).
65' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Thijs Dallinga is replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
63' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
61' Substitution. Kevin N'Doram walks off the pitch and Habib Maiga (Metz) comes on as a substitute.
59' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
56' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
54' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
54' The game is interrupted. Lamine Camara (Metz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
52' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
46' Laszlo Boloni makes a half-time substitution. Ablie Jallow comes on in place of Joel Asoro (Metz).
46' The game is over for Cheikh Sabaly. Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Laszlo Boloni decided to make a change. Arthur Atta is replaced by Lamine Camara (Metz).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Simon Elisor (Metz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mikkel Desler (Toulouse).
45+2' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:3.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' 2 - 0 Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way inside the right post and hits the net.
41' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' Koffi Kouao (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Alexandre Oukidja makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) after a cross from the side.
36' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' Koffi Kouao (Metz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gael Angoula has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' 1 - 0 Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
31' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
28' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Alexandre Oukidja makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) after a cross from the side.

25' Joel Asoro (Metz) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
23' The referee blows for a cooling break.
22' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
20' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
17' Christophe Herelle (Metz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

15' Toulouse slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
13' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
12' Fali Cande (Metz) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
11' The referee blows his whistle as Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) was too aggressive in his challenge.
9' Logan Costa (Toulouse) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
6' Dangerous play by Christophe Herelle (Metz). Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
3' What a big chance! Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula was nominated as the referee for this game.
